title: 第9章 紫府开缝仙道重启第10章 目标 阵道
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
池水之中，水雾回落，度凌慢慢抬头，喃喃道：“这就是红尘之乐？还真是入骨入髓入脑入心也。难怪修行路上，总是会有人惑于红尘……”
突然，他的声音戛然而止。
他的目光落在这株青莲之上。
青莲在迷离的星光下摇曳。
青莲叶面，不知何时出现了一颗晶莹的露珠，滚来滚去，每一个滚蛋，都充满玄妙的天机。
“你流泪了？”度凌一声轻呼。
青莲之上，灵光微动，那个小绿女呈现。
这一刻的她，似乎变了一幅模样。
虽然依然是拇指大小，但是，她脸上有了红霞：“嗯。”
“你的泪，不是为天机而流吗？难道说，跟女人办这个，就是天机？”
“我也不知道，我还小……可能……可能这滴泪为羞愧而流吧。”小绿女握着脸，从指缝里瞅他。
“我日……羞愧？”
“嗯，你自己不知羞耻，只有我代你羞耻了……”
“去你的！”度凌手指一点，点在这颗露珠之上，露珠随手指而上，化为一道流光直入他的识海。
一片迷蒙幽深的识海之中，喀地一声轻响，开了一道缝。
虽然只是一道缝隙，但是，他的心头宛若大浪翻天。
因为这代表着紫府五门之一的水门，破劫重开！
水门开缝，一缕封存十三年的仙气，顺着一条勉强还能通行的主脉，到了他的指尖。
这缕仙气，不到他全盛时期的万分之一，极其微弱，但是，却如同刚刚出生的婴儿，无比的纯净……
小绿女一声惨叫：“我好不容易恢复一点点气机，你一下子给吸走了，我完蛋了，遇到你个负心汉，这一辈子可怎么活……”

她的虚影伴随着无边的幽怨，慢慢消失。
度凌却笑了，碧水青莲已经激活。
现在的它，玄阴之气不再是必需。
它要的，是海量的天地元气。
而天地元气，在这方世界太过稀薄。
若是不用点特殊手段，它的成长期，将会漫长得让人怀疑人生……
清晨。
春日的暖阳撕破了剑门最高山峰的迷雾，将第一缕灿烂投入了圣女峰一座东向的房间。
这个房间，是西门二丝的住所。
她坐在梳妆台前，轻轻地梳着自己的秀发。
秀发早已柔顺无比，但她还在梳，这就不知道梳的是啥了，或许是秀发，或许是有点乱的心情……
content_en:
In the pool, the mist fell back. Du Ling slowly raised his head and murmured: "Is this the joy of the world of mortals? It really penetrates into the bones, marrow, brain and heart. No wonder there are always people who are confused by the world of mortals on the path of cultivation..."
Suddenly, his voice stopped.
His eyes fell on this green lotus.
The green lotus sways under the blurred starlight.
On the green lotus leaf, a crystal dewdrop appeared at some point, rolling around, and every roll was full of mysterious heavenly secrets.
"Are you crying?" Du Ling called out softly.
Above the green lotus, the spiritual light moved slightly, and the little green girl appeared.
At this moment, she seemed to have changed.
Although it was still the size of a thumb, there was a blush on her face: "Yeah."
"Aren't your tears shed because of Tianji? Could it be said that doing this with a woman is Tianji?"
"I don't know, I'm still young...maybe...maybe these tears were shed out of shame." The little green girl held her face and looked at him through her fingers.
"Am I... ashamed?"
"Well, you yourself have no shame, only I can be ashamed for you..."
"Fuck you!" Du Ling pointed his finger at the dewdrop. The dewdrop followed his finger and turned into a stream of light that went straight into his sea of consciousness.
In the misty and deep sea of ​​consciousness, there was a soft click, and a crack opened.
Although it was just a gap, his heart felt like a huge wave.
Because this means that Shuimen, one of the five gates of the Purple Mansion, has been re-opened after the catastrophe!
Minato opened a crack, and a wisp of immortal energy that had been sealed for thirteen years reached his fingertips along a main vein that was barely passable.
This ray of immortal energy is less than one ten thousandth of what it was in his heyday, and is extremely weak, but it is like a newly born baby, extremely pure...
The little green girl screamed: "I finally recovered a little energy, but you sucked it away all at once. I'm finished. How can I survive in this life if I meet you, a heartless man..."
Her shadow slowly disappeared along with the boundless resentment.
Du Ling smiled, and the blue water and green lotus had been activated.
Now, Xuanyin Qi is no longer necessary for it.
What it wants is a massive amount of vitality from heaven and earth.
The vitality of heaven and earth is too thin in this world.
If no special measures are used, its growth period will be so long that people will doubt their life...
Early morning.
The warm spring sun tore through the fog on the highest peak of Jianmen, casting the first ray of brightness into an east-facing room on Saintess' Peak.
This room is Ximen Ersi’s residence.
She sat in front of the dressing table and gently combed her hair.
Her hair was already extremely smooth, but she was still combing it. She didn't know what she was combing. Maybe it was her hair, or maybe she was feeling a little messy...
